human_outcome: Heat illness and impaired access to safe work, food and water
ecosystem_outcome: Present climate-attributable loss of habitat condition across land and sea
boundary: Consolidated current warming consequences; no projected tipping-point collapse, all-cause disaster total or historical-duration multiplier

human_outcome: Heat and ozone-related health and function loss attributable to methane
ecosystem_outcome: Current habitat condition loss attributable to methane-related warming
boundary: Human-caused methane contribution; concentration is context and not an annual harmed-person count

human_outcome: Impaired local water, food and livelihood function after forest conversion
ecosystem_outcome: Current condition deficit of converted forest habitat
boundary: Current unrecovered conversion stock; gross annual clearance is not multiplied by a decade or equated to wholly destroyed condition

human_outcome: Pollution and water-related health and function losses around intensive production
ecosystem_outcome: Current soil, freshwater and habitat condition loss from intensive agriculture
boundary: Assess production pressures and outcomes together; food provision is not itself harmful and ecosystem classes are integrated once

human_outcome: Water and livelihood losses attributable to resource-intensive demand
ecosystem_outcome: Current land and water condition deficit associated with additional production
boundary: Demand is not food insecurity; estimate adverse production consequences without adding the farming node score

human_outcome: Heat and flood-related impairment in poorly protected urban growth
ecosystem_outcome: Habitat and hydrologic condition loss on converted urban land
boundary: Urban population is not harmed population; count additional adverse consequences rather than all city life

human_outcome: Occupational, pollution and water-access loss attributable to rapid clothing turnover
ecosystem_outcome: Present land and water condition deficit from textile production and disposal
boundary: Separate production and disposal pathways within one consolidated estimate; no score from sales volume alone

human_outcome: Loss of safe housing and essential function during environmentally linked displacement
ecosystem_outcome: Localized habitat pressure associated with forced relocation
boundary: Displacement-equivalent function proxy; voluntary beneficial movement is excluded and repeat movements are not distinct people

human_outcome: Loss of reliable water, food and resource-dependent livelihoods
ecosystem_outcome: Current depletion-related soil, freshwater and habitat condition deficits
boundary: Resource stocks are not human harm; consolidate actual shortages and degraded condition without adding related nodes

human_outcome: Current warming-related health and essential-function loss allocated to fossil and industrial CO2
ecosystem_outcome: Current climate-related habitat condition loss allocated to fossil and industrial CO2
boundary: Bound fossil-industrial inventory; no concentration-as-emissions substitution or annual-flow-as-accumulated-harm identity

human_outcome: Air-pollution and climate-related health and function loss from personal transport
ecosystem_outcome: Current climate, land and water condition loss attributable to personal transport
boundary: Consolidated source contribution; injuries unrelated to environmental pathways and other transport sectors are excluded

human_outcome: Additional health and essential-service impairment from interacting hazards
ecosystem_outcome: Current integrated habitat damage associated with compound events
boundary: Use the combined outcome once; do not add separate heat, drought and flood totals for overlapping episodes

human_outcome: Recent heat, water and food losses attributable to adverse warm-phase episodes
ecosystem_outcome: Current residual drought and marine habitat impairment after recent warm-phase episodes
boundary: Adverse realized recent consequences are a current annual-equivalent proxy, not a forecast or all exposed tropical populations

human_outcome: Flood, livelihood and water-function losses from adverse cool-phase episodes
ecosystem_outcome: Residual terrestrial and freshwater habitat damage after adverse cool-phase episodes
boundary: Phase-neutral comparison; warming or cooling index values alone do not establish harm

human_outcome: Limited present coastal and fishery-function loss attributable to circulation changes
ecosystem_outcome: Current marine habitat condition deficit attributable to circulation change
boundary: Small present-effect working estimate; excludes a future collapse and does not treat one transport reading as a verified trend

human_outcome: Illness and impaired safe work during humid heat
ecosystem_outcome: Localized present habitat impairment associated with humid-heat events
boundary: Actual adverse humid-heat consequences are estimated; humidity and the population under a threshold are exposure only

human_outcome: Disrupted food, water and work from poorly timed rainy seasons
ecosystem_outcome: Current rain-timing-related loss of soil and freshwater condition
boundary: Within-season timing losses, not the whole population or all rainfall variability

human_outcome: Impaired housing, transport and water function in thaw-affected communities
ecosystem_outcome: Current ground, wetland and tundra habitat condition loss
boundary: Current thaw damage; released carbon pathways are consolidated, not scored from future methane-release scenarios

human_outcome: Current flood-related health and essential-function losses in snow-fed catchments
ecosystem_outcome: Residual stream and riparian condition damage from rain-on-snow floods
boundary: Recent realized flood consequences as annual-equivalent proxy; exposed catchments alone do not constitute damage

human_outcome: Present dry-season water-function losses after local peak meltwater supply
ecosystem_outcome: Current stream and riparian condition deficit downstream of depleted ice
boundary: Only catchments with present declining supply; no global future peak date or all mountain-dependent people as harm

human_outcome: Water-contact and seafood-related illness from expanding pathogen activity
ecosystem_outcome: Current pathogen-related coastal animal and habitat condition loss
boundary: Observed adverse pathways, excluding potential new range area as if already damaged

human_outcome: Fishery and food-function impairment from reduced marine mixing
ecosystem_outcome: Present oxygen, nutrient and community condition loss in poorly mixed waters
boundary: Integrated condition deficit, not stratification anomaly directly converted to habitat destruction

human_outcome: Loss of usable water, crop output and livelihood function in affected deltas
ecosystem_outcome: Current freshwater and riparian condition deficit from salt penetration
boundary: Only adverse salinity outcomes; combine crop and drinking-water impairment without counting resulting health loss twice

human_outcome: Fishery and coastal food-function losses from adverse nutrient-supply changes
ecosystem_outcome: Current production and food-web condition loss in disrupted upwelling systems
boundary: Nutrient transport is an intermediate; beneficial or neutral circulation changes are not scored as damage

human_outcome: Flood-related illness, displacement and essential-service impairment
ecosystem_outcome: Current erosion and freshwater habitat damage from extreme rainfall
boundary: Recent realized harmful rainfall outcomes; rainfall mass and exposed people are not native harm units

human_outcome: Additional storm-related health and service losses associated with rapid strengthening
ecosystem_outcome: Residual coastal habitat damage attributable to rapidly strengthening storms
boundary: Incremental rapid-intensification consequence, not every tropical-cyclone impact

human_outcome: Additional smoke-health and essential-function impairment from high smoke injection
ecosystem_outcome: Current habitat condition loss associated with fire-driven storm episodes
boundary: High-altitude injection contribution only; the whole originating wildfire is not assigned again

human_outcome: Impaired housing and access where thawing coasts retreat
ecosystem_outcome: Current coastal tundra habitat loss and condition deficit
boundary: Affected community and shoreline footprint, excluding all Arctic residents and future shoreline retreat

human_outcome: Present loss of reliable water and water-dependent food or work
ecosystem_outcome: Current freshwater condition loss where withdrawals constrain environmental water
boundary: Actually harmed share is an internal estimate; stress ratios and exposed population are context only

human_outcome: Water and farm-function losses from unrecovered groundwater depletion
ecosystem_outcome: Current groundwater-fed river and wetland condition deficits

human_outcome: Years of life lost from deaths attributable to heat
ecosystem_outcome: No separate ecological outcome within this explicitly human mortality endpoint
boundary: Internal mean life-years assumption; life-years lost are not multiplied by exposure days or a second persistence factor

human_outcome: Joint ambient and household air-pollution attributable health loss
ecosystem_outcome: No separate ecological outcome within this human health endpoint
boundary: WHO joint DALY endpoint is the magnitude anchor; not an age-standardized death rate times population

human_outcome: Heat-related health and safe-work function losses in affected workers
ecosystem_outcome: No independent habitat loss within the worker-exposure boundary
boundary: Harmed workers are estimated separately from workers exposed; work time, health and income effects are consolidated

human_outcome: Power, water and pollution-related health and function losses attributable to computing facilities
ecosystem_outcome: Current climate and local water condition deficit attributable to computing facilities
boundary: Environmental consequences, not compute traffic or facility count; operating footprint excludes all internet infrastructure

human_outcome: Power and water-related health and function losses attributable to AI computing
ecosystem_outcome: Current climate and local water condition deficit attributable to AI computing
boundary: AI subset of computing activity; no addition to the data-center score or automatic risk premium for AI

human_outcome: Pollution and local water-function losses attributable to chip fabrication
ecosystem_outcome: Current water and habitat condition deficit around production and supply routes

human_outcome: Environmental service interruption and power-related function loss in core communications
ecosystem_outcome: Current habitat and climate condition loss attributable to core communications infrastructure
boundary: Affected service user-time rather than every internet user; communication losses are not assumed to be health losses

human_outcome: Essential communication-function loss and environmental operation-related harm
ecosystem_outcome: Current habitat and climate condition deficit attributable to wireless networks
boundary: One consolidated operating and disruption footprint; subscribers are not harmed-person counts

human_outcome: Essential communication-function loss during environment-linked hub disruption
ecosystem_outcome: Small current local condition deficit attributable to exchange facilities
boundary: Scope is exchange hubs rather than all data centers, cables or internet use

human_outcome: Essential communication-function impairment during cable-route disruption
ecosystem_outcome: Current seabed condition disturbance from cable infrastructure
boundary: Do not assign every network user's life a full loss-year; environmental disruption contribution only

human_outcome: Pollution and lost food-access function attributable to avoidable wastage
ecosystem_outcome: Present land, water and climate condition deficit associated with wasted food
boundary: Estimate adverse consequences of wasted production and disposal once; wasted tonnes are not malnutrition counts

human_outcome: Current pollution, noise and climate-related health and function losses from aviation
ecosystem_outcome: Current climate and habitat condition deficit attributable to aviation
boundary: Consolidated fuel and non-CO2 pathways; do not add airport exposure or separate contrail scores

human_outcome: Current air-pollution, climate and essential-delivery function losses from shipping
ecosystem_outcome: Current climate and marine condition deficit attributable to navigation

human_outcome: Current pollution and climate-related health and function loss attributable to cement and concrete
ecosystem_outcome: Current quarry, water and climate-related habitat condition deficit

human_outcome: Current particulate and climate-related health and function losses from metal production
ecosystem_outcome: Current extraction, production and climate habitat condition deficits
boundary: Bound production and supply chain; direct industrial DALYs do not include every climate or mining pathway

human_outcome: Pollution and climate-related health and essential-function losses from petrochemicals
ecosystem_outcome: Present habitat and water condition deficits from production and persistent waste

human_outcome: Pollution and warming-related health loss attributable to operation and refrigerant leakage
ecosystem_outcome: Present climate and local water condition deficit from cooling equipment

human_outcome: Current manufacturing pollution and climate-related health and function loss
ecosystem_outcome: Current plant, supply-chain and climate habitat condition deficits

human_outcome: Occupational, pollution and water-function losses from mineral extraction

human_outcome: Heat, flood and access-related function loss from poorly connected outward growth

human_outcome: Current water and livelihood function losses from pumping beyond recharge
ecosystem_outcome: Current groundwater-fed habitat condition deficits

human_outcome: Water, farming and power-function losses from adverse seasonal river changes
ecosystem_outcome: Current river and floodplain condition deficits from altered flow timing

human_outcome: Impaired water and energy access due to unstable usable storage

human_outcome: Essential water and power function unmet by reservoir operation

human_outcome: Present seasonal water-function loss associated with mistimed snowmelt

human_outcome: Current food, water and livelihood function losses in severely dried landscapes

human_outcome: Health, displacement and essential-access loss from rapidly rising floods

human_outcome: Persistent loss of reliable food, water and safe livelihood function
ecosystem_outcome: Current accumulated drought-related soil and habitat condition deficits

human_outcome: Loss of usable island water and related essential function
ecosystem_outcome: Current freshwater-dependent island habitat condition deficit

human_outcome: Unsafe-water health and safe-supply function losses during treatment constraints
ecosystem_outcome: Current local freshwater impairment associated with intake and treatment disruption

human_outcome: Water-quality and livelihood function loss downstream of forest removal
ecosystem_outcome: Current catchment habitat, erosion and water-condition deficits

human_outcome: Illness and usable-water function losses during sewer and treatment overflow

human_outcome: Pollution-related health and water-function loss from bypassed treatment

human_outcome: Food and water-function losses where avoidable irrigation losses constrain supply

human_outcome: Essential electricity-function loss from adverse river-generation shortfalls
ecosystem_outcome: Current adverse habitat consequences of reliability-driven flow management

human_outcome: Water and livelihood function loss under unresolved sharing failures
ecosystem_outcome: Current river and floodplain condition deficits from adverse allocation failures

human_outcome: Current water-service vulnerability realized in outages and environmental operating losses

human_outcome: Present coastal service and displacement-function loss attributable to ice-sheet contributions
ecosystem_outcome: Current coastal and ice-associated habitat condition deficit attributable to ice-sheet loss

human_outcome: Annual-equivalent recent flood-related loss in downstream communities

human_outcome: Present loss of safe travel and food-access function in ice-dependent communities

human_outcome: Current coastal flood-related health and essential-service function losses
ecosystem_outcome: Residual coastal freshwater and habitat condition deficit after flooding

human_outcome: Present housing, access and usable-water function loss in subsiding landscapes

human_outcome: Current pollution and access-function loss attributable to expanded Arctic navigation
ecosystem_outcome: Localized present Arctic marine disturbance and pollution condition deficit
boundary: Observed navigation footprint, not potential routes made ice-free or future ship counts

human_outcome: Essential housing, transport and energy-function loss from polar infrastructure failures
ecosystem_outcome: Localized present habitat impairment associated with failures and repair
boundary: Actually disrupted communities and sites, excluding all polar infrastructure exposure

human_outcome: Present dry-season water and livelihood function deficits after poor snow storage
ecosystem_outcome: Current snow-fed terrestrial and freshwater condition deficit
boundary: Available snow-water equivalent is context; harmed user-time and condition are separate estimates

human_outcome: Small present coastal function loss associated with diminished ice-sheet meltwater retention

human_outcome: Present dry-season water and livelihood function loss in adversely affected glacier-fed users
ecosystem_outcome: Current river and riparian condition deficit from reduced or mistimed glacier contribution

human_outcome: Current food and fishery-livelihood function loss from oxygen-limited marine systems

human_outcome: Limited present fishery and food-function loss attributable to changed deep-water renewal
ecosystem_outcome: Current deep-sea community condition deficit associated with adverse ventilation change

human_outcome: Current shellfish and reef-dependent food and livelihood function loss
ecosystem_outcome: Present shell-forming and reef-community condition deficit attributable to acidification

human_outcome: Current adverse fishery and water-function losses associated with Pacific variability

human_outcome: Limited present coastal food and water-function losses linked to adverse Atlantic variability

human_outcome: Food and water-function losses during adverse tropical Atlantic episodes

human_outcome: Present food, water and livelihood function losses under adverse rainfall shifts

human_outcome: Current protein-access and fishery-livelihood function loss from depleted stocks

human_outcome: Protein-access and livelihood function losses when seafood fails to reach users
ecosystem_outcome: Small current condition deficit associated with spoilage and disrupted landing operations

human_outcome: Present coastal food and livelihood function losses from adverse circulation changes
ecosystem_outcome: Current marine community and habitat condition deficits under adverse circulation changes

human_outcome: Fishery and coastal food-function loss attributable to low oxygen
ecosystem_outcome: Present coastal animal and food-web condition deficit in oxygen-poor habitats

human_outcome: Current food and fishery-function losses from adverse feeding-network reorganization
ecosystem_outcome: Present marine composition and function condition deficits

human_outcome: Limited current coastal food-function losses attributable to adverse salinity layering

human_outcome: Illness and seafood or water-function loss during harmful blooms
ecosystem_outcome: Current aquatic condition deficits from toxic, shading or oxygen-depleting episodes

human_outcome: Food and livelihood function loss where familiar pelagic stocks become less accessible
ecosystem_outcome: Current adverse community and habitat-function deficit from redistribution

human_outcome: Current annual-equivalent coastal storm-surge health and essential-function loss

human_outcome: Present warming-related health and function loss allocated to diminished terrestrial uptake

human_outcome: Current smoke, water and climate-related health or function loss from peat oxidation
ecosystem_outcome: Current peat-soil and wetland condition deficits from adverse drying and oxidation

human_outcome: Current coastal protection and livelihood function loss associated with damaged carbon-storing wetlands
ecosystem_outcome: Present condition deficit in affected tidal wetlands

human_outcome: Present warming-related health and function loss allocated to reduced ocean uptake
ecosystem_outcome: Present adverse marine condition deficit associated with reduced uptake

human_outcome: Health, sleep and safe-recovery function loss during hot nights
ecosystem_outcome: Limited current habitat condition deficit associated with persistent warm nights

human_outcome: Continuous heat-related health and function loss without nighttime recovery

human_outcome: Current housing, work and food-function loss from adverse hail changes

human_outcome: Current adverse water and food-function losses during tropical rainfall disturbances

human_outcome: Current adverse seasonal water, heat and essential-function losses

human_outcome: Adverse cold, heat and transport-function losses associated with current circulation variability

human_outcome: Current water, food and access-function loss during adverse regional weather phases
ecosystem_outcome: Residual regional habitat condition deficits after adverse phases

human_outcome: Present water and coastal livelihood function loss from adverse westerly-wind shifts
ecosystem_outcome: Current adverse marine and terrestrial condition deficit associated with wind shifts

human_outcome: Small attributable current essential-function loss mediated through adverse weather
ecosystem_outcome: Small current habitat condition deficit attributable to adverse mediated changes

human_outcome: Current health, water and livelihood function losses from prolonged adverse weather
ecosystem_outcome: Present terrestrial and freshwater habitat deficit after persistent adverse episodes

human_outcome: Additional heat and heavy-rain health or function losses attributable to moisture changes

human_outcome: Health and essential-function loss from fires ignited during adverse lightning conditions

human_outcome: Current water, food and work-function losses associated with adverse drying demand
ecosystem_outcome: Present soil and vegetation condition deficit attributable to excess drying

human_outcome: Present water and warming-related function loss attributable to darkened snow

human_outcome: Additional respiratory and function losses from climate-amplified surface ozone
ecosystem_outcome: Current ozone-related vegetation condition deficit attributable to weather amplification

human_outcome: Current health, water and food-function loss associated with adverse persistent weather
ecosystem_outcome: Residual terrestrial habitat impairment attributable to stalled weather patterns

human_outcome: Current smoke-related health and essential-function loss

human_outcome: Limited current heat and coastal function loss attributable to adverse cloud decline

human_outcome: Current additional heat-related health and function loss from reduced aerosol cooling

human_outcome: Current pollution and climate health or function loss from retained peak generation

human_outcome: Present electricity-access function loss from delayed repairs and connections

human_outcome: Current pollution, fuel-price and power-access health or function loss linked to gas reliance

human_outcome: Current pollution and climate-related health or function loss from retained fossil industrial heat

human_outcome: Current climate-related health and function loss allocated to cement process CO2

human_outcome: Current climate and pollution-related health or function loss from retained high-emission steel methods

human_outcome: Present pollution, occupational and water-function losses under accelerated extraction pressure

human_outcome: Present worker and water-function loss from adverse battery-material supply practices

human_outcome: Current water-access and essential-function loss where cooling demands constrain other uses

human_outcome: Current additional pollution and climate-related health or function loss from increased flying

human_outcome: Current food, medicine and livelihood function loss from blocked navigation routes
